version: R1 complete OTT-Vid multi-image and DeepStack adaptation; 2026-10-05
selection_dtype: CPU float32 using current native BF16 projector and saliency
saliency: last actual vision attention, mean over heads/queries, sum each actual spatial merge group
coverage_weight: original-token saliency wi, no redundancy penalty
spatial_coordinates: merged grid x/(W-1), y/(H-1), singleton axis 0
spatial_budget: round(N * retention**(1-temporal_share)), at least 2 and at most N
temporal_budget: max(0, K*F - round(F*N*retention)), official final target after rounded spatial K
allocation: negative-softmax capped by K-1 source tokens per pair, redistribute overflow, largest fractional remainder, earliest tie
matching: raw coupling decreasing, original destination/source lexicographic tie, source used at most once; destination unrestricted
cost_split: cost <= threshold merges; higher cost prunes source and its complete low-cost descendant subtree
aggregation: unweighted float32 mean of each complete component; same source members for projector and every DeepStack
root_positions: chronological original root's complete native mRoPE triple; all text/image boundaries retained
